source:
name: Coverage

# Portfolio's repository health check compares this repository's reported
# coverage commit against its verified default-branch head
# (`src/lib/health.ts`). A coverage report that names an older commit is graded
# `mismatched`, which becomes an ERROR after 180 minutes — not a warning. So
# coverage has to be re-reported on every default-branch push; a periodic-only
# report breaks the moment anyone pushes here. The daily run exists only to keep
# `source_reported_at` inside the 48-hour staleness window on quiet weeks.

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: "45 3 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: coverage-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  coverage:
    name: Coverage report
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - name: Run authoritative coverage suite
        id: coverage
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          npm run test:coverage 2>&1 | tee coverage-output.txt
          METRICS=$(node scripts/coverage-metrics.mjs coverage-output.txt --discover .)
          node -e '
            const m = JSON.parse(process.argv[1]);
            process.stdout.write([
              `test_count=${m.testCount}`,
              `test_files=${m.testFiles ?? ""}`,
              `tests_passed=${m.passed}`,
              `tests_failed=${m.failed}`,
              `coverage_percent=${m.coverage}`,
            ].join("\n") + "\n");
          ' "$METRICS" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Report coverage to Portfolio
        env:
          COVERAGE_SECRET: ${{ secrets.COVERAGE_SECRET }}
          REPO: juan294/paisaxe
          TEST_COUNT: ${{ steps.coverage.outputs.test_count }}
          TEST_FILES: ${{ steps.coverage.outputs.test_files }}
          TESTS_PASSED: ${{ steps.coverage.outputs.tests_passed }}
          TESTS_FAILED: ${{ steps.coverage.outputs.tests_failed }}
          COVERAGE_PERCENT: ${{ steps.coverage.outputs.coverage_percent }}
          SOURCE_COMMIT_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          COVERAGE_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
          COVERAGE_WORKFLOW_REF: ${{ github.workflow_ref }}
          SOURCE_TARGET_BRANCH: main
        run: bash scripts/report-coverage.sh
